notes.title: Get Crestfallen at 25% off for Todays Wipe!
notes.content:
[b]Loyal warriors, noble knights, and cunning tradesmen of Crestfallen,[/b]

The servers shall be wiped this day, washing away the ruins of past battles and the echoes of old feuds. From the ashes of the fallen, a new age shall rise, and with it, the opportunity for all to seize glory anew.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/1c307f6dff203b2269123e58e3dbfbf93bbba1e2.png[/img]
The battlefield is now balanced, the kingdoms erased from the annals of history. No longer do the mightiest lords stand atop their towering fortresses, for all shall now begin once more with naught but their wits, their steel, and the will to forge a dominion anew. A fairer time of conquest now dawns upon us.

[b]A Clean Slate – The Call to Arms![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/d560f910d0f85f4d07107e6a8e677ca3395ccf4b.png[/img]
Gone are the gilded halls of yesteryear, razed by the hands of time. The castles that once stood as symbols of dominion now rest only in memory, their stones scattered to the winds. No man, no guild, no faction shall claim an advantage over another. The slate is wiped clean, and with it, all shall be given equal footing upon this sacred land.

The anvil calls for new smiths, the forests yearn for the lumberjack’s axe, and the fields whisper for the touch of the farmer’s plow. Warriors, craftsmen, and scholars alike must take up their tools and weapons, for the struggle begins anew!

[b]Knights, Lords, and Rogues – Reclaim Thy Honor![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/5d9d423a4344ceb1a9210e80c0deaac14139f804.png[/img]

Let it be known across the land! Those who once held dominion over vast territories must now once again prove their worth. The mighty must rise from humble beginnings, and those who once faltered may now take up their swords with newfound ambition.

Gather thy guilds, summon thy brethren, and prepare once more to stake thy claim upon the world. Shall the old alliances rekindle, or shall new banners be raised in defiance of past tyrants? The throne stands empty, the crown unclaimed, and fate favors the bold.

[b]A Battlefield Reborn![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/05028776ed4e7891b4afef3b19446bc086e48607.jpg[/img]
With this cleansing comes not only renewal but also balance. No longer shall one house overshadow another before the battle hath even begun. Every knight, every rogue, every peasant turned warrior shall have their chance to forge their own destiny.

The strong shall not rest too soon, for the tides of war are ever shifting. New tactics must be devised, new strongholds erected, and new dominions carved from the wilderness. The iron-hearted shall rise once more, and the meek shall find their courage or be swept away like chaff before the storm.

[b]The Warhorn Sounds – Will Ye Heed the Call?[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/363d02e61cbab32cba2f42004b3470578e66fdae.png[/img]
Lords and ladies, mercenaries and kings-to-be, the time for hesitation hath passed. The banners of yore are gone, their legends now but tales to be sung by bards. Only those with the will to carve their mark upon the realm shall be remembered in this new age.

As the sun rises upon this new day, so too does the opportunity for glory and power. Sharpen thy swords, gather thy allies, and prepare to ride forth into this reborn realm. The battlefield beckons, the castles await their builders, and the throne stands empty.

This day, Crestfallen is cleansed, and with it, the fate of the land lies in thine hands.

Go forth, warriors, and seize thy destiny!

[h1]King Burkheart The Keeper of Justice
"JUSTICE WILL BE SERVED!!"
[/h1]

notes.title: The Forge of Iron and Steel Burns Hot - Conquest The Realm of Tyraellia
notes.content:
[i]The heralds sing of momentous tidings from the lands of Crestfallen: a bountiful transformation has swept across our world, promising fairer fortunes and newfound perils alike. Gather thy wits and steady thy blade as we recount these updates, crafted by the hands of our guilded artisans and sorcerers. Heed well, for the realm flourishes anew.[/i]
[h2]The Harvest Re-Scattered: Nodes of Plenty and Purpose[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/95ce7881fd252fae29a8b726ac1dfb1939427f56.jpg[/img]
In the name of balance and prosperity, the resources of Crestfallen have been re-scattered across the land. No longer shall ye wander aimlessly in search of precious ores, rare herbs, or timber. Nodes now lie plentiful and more thoughtfully placed, with their locations attuned to the needs of craftsmen and gatherers. Seek thy bounty in regions where it doth most belong: iron near the craggy heights, herbs within meadows kissed by morning dew, and lumber by rivers where life teems.

This restructuring ensures that all adventurers, be they seasoned veterans or fledgling explorers, shall find the fruits of the land more readily at hand. Go forth and reap what the gods have scattered!

[h2]Banishing the Haunt of Floating Oddities and Treacherous Trenches[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/ef1bda995cb1dc734f7d2a6ed11c526e86c46b1f.jpg[/img]
The artisans of Crestfallen have worked tirelessly to mend the world’s imperfections. Gone are the mysterious floating objects that once marred the skies, strange specters of what should lie grounded. Similarly, the cruel terrain traps that ensnared many an unwary traveler have been filled, smoothed, and sealed by the earth’s embrace. Let none fear stumbling into these deceptive chasms again!

Rejoice, for the land now stands firm and fair beneath thy feet. Thy travels shall henceforth be unmarred by such wayward pitfalls.

[h2]Treasures Beckon: Riches Enhanced in the Demonic Ruins[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/627303ca8b7530b390848a8ae7d544d43146fca8.jpg[/img]
The dark corridors of the Demonic Ruins, steeped in shadow and menace, now promise greater rewards for the brave who dare tread their depths. Whispers tell of relics and spoils awaiting the bold, their worth now heightened to reflect the dangers lurking within.

But tread carefully, for where treasures grow more plentiful, so too does the vigilance of the dark guardians who covet them. Sharpen thy steel, muster thy courage, and claim what is rightfully thine.

[h2]Fortune Within the Orcen Encampment of RockThralm[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/c1e21e3f3c1b16f71261f9ab0876aac15ab2e836.jpg[/img]
The Orcen encampment at RockThralm has become an even greater lure for adventurers seeking fame and wealth. Their strongboxes brim with treasures untold, their loot enhanced to entice the most daring of raiders. The clang of their hammers and guttural war cries echo through the hills, forewarning of their fierce resolve.

Should thou venture into the encampment, remember: riches await only those with the strength to conquer and the wisdom to retreat when danger swells. Assemble thy companions and let the plunder of RockThralm add glory to thy name.

[h2]Thinning the Forests: A Path Clearer Through the Wilds[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/dcbf55a0acd2268b7f398ebf152ce83b36c411b9.jpg[/img]
The dense, labyrinthine forests of Crestfallen, though fair and full of mystery, have been tempered by the axe of reason. Many trees have been felled, allowing clearer passage and kinder navigation through these verdant realms. No longer shall adventurers find themselves lost for hours amid endless groves.

These changes, though subtle, open the lands to greater exploration. Yet take heed, for even thinned forests may still conceal danger. The wilds remain ever untamed, and shadows linger amidst the glades.

[h2]Cleansing the Blight of Wayward Nodes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/1366be0d5a66ebf3cdbb99ed3e74ba0cd9c8e44d.jpg[/img]
A vexing curse hath been lifted! Resource nodes, once plagued by strange respawn behaviors, have been cleansed of their mischief. Miners and gatherers alike shall now find the land’s bounty behaving as intended, reappearing with the natural rhythm of the realm.

No more shall thou wait in frustration or find thy resources gone awry. This restoration of harmony ensures that the industrious may work with peace of mind.

[h2]The Saving Grace: Vanquishing the Character Reset Curse[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/3b51dedf469a4ff79df0f2f8ebc7ce5a00a4de08.jpg[/img]
Hear ye, hear ye! A great bane hath been driven from our lands—the dreaded curse that would reset thy character upon exit hath met its end. To achieve this victory, a player-save mechanism hath been strengthened, ensuring thy hard-won progress remains steadfast.

While we offer this fix with hearts full of hope, we beseech thee to report any lingering traces of the reset blight. Should its foul vestiges remain, know that our battle against it shall endure until its eradication is absolute.

[h2]Looking Ahead: What Awaits Beyond the Horizon[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/bd442b19ba84372a53aa20aa7292885e10e42058.jpg[/img]
These changes mark but one chapter in the saga of Crestfallen. The winds of innovation stir evermore, and our guilds labor unceasingly to bring forth new wonders and resolve lingering woes. Thy feedback, dear adventurers, remains the cornerstone of our endeavors. Share thy tales, thy triumphs, and thy trials, and together we shall shape a world worthy of legends.

Prepare thy arms and gird thy spirit, for the realm of Crestfallen calls anew. Whether thou art drawn to the Demonic Ruins, the Orcen Encampment of RockThralm, or the serene glades of the re-sculpted forests, thy destiny awaits.

[h2]Closing Words of Gratitude and Resolve[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/57d9492fbafea74c8bb89fde349fb741dff9700a.jpg[/img]
We extend our deepest thanks to the valiant players who inhabit and enrich Crestfallen. Thy resilience, camaraderie, and passion inspire us to ever greater heights. As thy journey unfolds, may thy adventures be ever rewarding and thy spirit unyielding.

Until next we meet, may the stars guide thy path, and may thy endeavors bring glory to thy name.

Raise thy banners high and let the tales of thy deeds echo through Tyraellia!

King Burkheart The Keeper of Justice
"JUSTICE WILL BE SERVED!!"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/e0ec61a52734e5d3361d43def49cd16829abc10c.png[/img]

notes.title: Live by the Sword, Die by the Horde. The Orcen Lands Reinforced, Dragons Abound!
notes.content:
[h2]👑King’s Own Treasures Bestowed Upon Thee!💎[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/94a2bd794727cb1db1457eae242080af9163c48f.jpg[/img]
Rejoice, for the [b]king’s loot hath been increased[/b]! The chance of finding the coveted [b]sword hath been raised to 50%[/b], up from a mere 20%! Let this sharpen thy blade and bolster thy courage in future quests!

[h2]🐉The Dragons Are Full and Fat, Feasting on Survivors🔥[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/52d920f3a18f9941fd64046cc89da5704772600a.png[/img]
The mighty dragons, after feasting upon many a bold adventurer, hath become generous in their defeat! Upon slaying these beasts, ye shall now find [b]more gear and loot[/b] in their charred remains. The thrill of battle and the spoils of victory are ever in thy favor. 🏆

[h2]💀Orcen Lands Stir with Darker Forces🗡️[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/b346adba59d3f10d8be3298fdcfe87dc3eb3dc5f.jpg[/img]
The barren lands to the south hath become home to [b]more orcs[/b], as their forces grow stronger by the day. Venture with caution, for the Orcen hordes now roam the lands in greater numbers, reinforcing their claim upon the wastelands. The roads are perilous, but the rewards for victory doth make it all the more worthwhile!

[h2]🛡️Red Shield Knights Rally at the War Camp!⚔️[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/ec57452671f2ea8707efe4ffdb2af676ce33dc00.jpg[/img]
[b]Herald Gregor[/b], with his fresh recruits, hath begun training a new wave of [b]Red Shield Knights[/b] at the War Camp, just down the road. Ye shall see more of these valiant warriors patrolling the lands soon, ready to torment the realm with strength and steel. The time will soon come when you must choose a side.

[h2]📜Admin Panels Empower Server Lords👑[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/eecd2100f737d0a111c402642153190d77d580c6.jpg[/img]
All hail the server lords! The [b]Admin Panel[/b] is now [b]100% operational[/b] for all servers, even for those brave enough to host their own lands. Customize thy realm and rule with complete control. Player-hosted realms can now enjoy the full suite of administrative tools, giving thee the power to shape the land as thou seest fit! 🏞️

[h2]🏰Strengthened Defenses🛠️[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/c3c773019144b8dda256cec3626ca91f3a716d63.png[/img]
The walls of thine buildings and doors hath been [b]fortified[/b]! Their health hath been doubled, making it harder for thy enemies to breach thy fortresses. Build and defend thy lands with greater confidence!

[h2]⚔️Balance Hath Been Restored⚖️[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/8c07b51d06dc4bef0f4081074f4fb8f213463ea9.jpg[/img]
Thy armors and weapons hath been [b]balanced[/b], ensuring fairer battles and greater challenge. The battlefield shall now be a truer test of skill and wit! Higher tier, more expensive items are now much more powerful to better approach battles in the harder areas like Hell and the Orcen Lands.

[h2]🛠️SteamCMD Open to All Realms💾[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/55a7c83e57e2a75ed2cf6c828b1744e18e25f8d1.jpg[/img]
Good tidings for server hosts! [b]SteamCMD[/b] hath been established, allowing those who wish to host their own realms to easily pull the necessary files from a secure source. Customize thine own kingdom with ease, for the process hath been made simple and swift.

[h2]👂Hear Thy Fellow Adventurers!💬[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/95ebc53b14ba52618e3f97b3d73a58c21671f1e7.jpg[/img]
No longer shall thou miss the words of thy slanderous whispers! The [b]chat window[/b] now stayeth open longer after messages appear, allowing thee to see the words of others more clearly. Speak and be heard across the realm, and let no conversation be lost! More work on this planned soon.

[h2]🌾Farming Tools Hardened for the Harvest⚒️[/h2]
Congrats - Channing and Nox Aquilae, your guild won Castle of the Month and you got a new armor named after thy Guild! LEGENDARY!!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/83be58bb5939ac8e6d6699e4eae46554935fedaf.png[/img]
Thy [b]farming tools[/b] now hath [b]durability[/b], ensuring longer use as ye tend the land. The fields shall thrive, and the harvest shall be bountiful! + 75%  increase in durability on all tools.

[h2]🗺️Clarity Upon the Map✨[/h2]
Fear not getting lost, for a [b]high-visibility player marker[/b] hath been added to the map, ensuring that ye always know where ye stand in the vast expanse of Crestfallen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/78bef238d6e0f78375238aca4cda64d2b77fe9f7.png[/img]

[h2]⚖️Balanced Item Stacking📦[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/55a7c83e57e2a75ed2cf6c828b1744e18e25f8d1.jpg[/img]
Thy item stacking hath been adjusted to bring more balance to thy inventory. Store wisely and plan well, for balance hath been restored in thy goods!

[h2]🌿Terrain Restoration🌊[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/819e8275e2995b596d4aaec6d1463448475dc5e4.jpg[/img]
Low points in the land where water doth seep through hath been filled with dirt, restoring the terrain and allowing thee to travel without wet feet! Tread the realm in comfort and safety.

[h2]🛡️Safe Respawns Guaranteed🐺[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/4857d01f48ac60a1cceeba3d229ffdcd06c5426c.png[/img]
The menace of respawning near hostile wolves or other dangers hath been [b]removed[/b]! Fear not awakening beside thy enemies, for thou shalt be granted safer havens upon thy return to the world.

[h2][b]⚔️Go forth, adventurers! May these changes bring greater glory, riches, and adventures beyond thy wildest dreams.👑[/b][/h2]

[h1]I BEG OF YOU STOP RAIDING ME ON THE FIRST DAY, I REALLY WANT TO BUILD BIG!![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/0ff55e1f61fa1fdad3f5a80545f13feb2b35a48a.jpg[/img]

If there are specific changes you would like to see please reach out to us in Discord or on our discussion board, everyone is welcome to participate and join in on the journey. Good Luck and Have Fun! Congrats Kakimaru on the EPIC Castle!!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/6a5428b5d11ad6bbd7bd2c078cc2848514f22ac2.png[/img]

notes.title: 🔥 Wipe Hype Alert! 🚨 Crestfallen Zero to Hero Challenge is Here! 🏆 Make Ready
notes.content:
[h2]Hear Ye, Hear Ye! Brave Adventurers of Tyraellia,[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/8f7aff188cc043dc9f66eb1317ba5f2b7d0ee7ff.png[/img]

Lend thine ears, for great tidings come to thee regarding the ever-unfolding realm of [b]Crestfallen: Medieval Survival[/b]. Steel thyselves, for the winds of war blow stronger, the lands have been made more bountiful, and the dark forces from beyond stir once more.

[h3]Siege Weapons Return in Earnest![/h3]
By decree of the finest siege masters, mighty engines of war have returned to thine craftable arsenal. At the newly-established [b]Siege Workshop[/b], ye shall now construct these instruments of destruction, forged with a reduced cost and a bloodier bite! Chaos shalt reign supreme in battle as their damage hath been increased, ensuring thine enemies' defenses crumble swiftly beneath the force of your mighty blows. Prepare for warfare most savage as siege upon siege shakes the very stones of the realm.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HowziCSVEGI

[h1]Participate in Thy Tournament - The Zero to Hero Challenge is Upon us[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/70a14f7bfb8ef37c1b8d03a0ea9fbb6639f6fa1a.jpg[/img]

On this very day, as the skies clear and the ground is wiped anew, a mighty [b]Community Event[/b] shall take place! Gather ye, bold souls, for the [b]Crestfallen Zero to Hero Challenge[/b] begins at the strike of 10 in the morn (PST). Warriors, craftsfolk, and explorers alike, all shall start with naught but their wits, and from these humble beginnings, rise to claim glory eternal.

[h1]Join thy Discord to Compete - [url=https://discord.gg/bK8hy3QxXZ]https://discord.gg/bK8hy3QxXZ[/url][/h1]

[h3]Date & Time[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Date:[/b] This Saturday, the 14th day of the month
[*][b]Time:[/b] 10:00 AM (PST)
[*][b]Server:[/b] [US EAST PVP]
[*][b]Location:[/b] The Realm of Crestfallen (in-game)
[/list]

[h3]The Challenge Awaits:[/h3]
Embark upon this perilous trial and test thy mettle! The [b]Zero to Hero Challenge[/b] bids thee to start with nothing but the clothes on thy back—nay, not even that, for thou shalt begin with naught—and rise through a series of challenges that shall test thy skill, endurance, and cunning. Canst thou survive, build, fight, and emerge as the true hero of Crestfallen?

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Sf0hwdXHPmE

[h3]Event Overview:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Objective:[/b] Complete a list of arduous trials in a set order, all within the swift span of two hours.
[*][b]Starting Conditions:[/b] Ye shall begin with [b]no items[/b], [b]no armor[/b], and [b]no weaponry[/b] (naked start).
[*][b]Time Limit:[/b] Two hours to ascend from [b]zero[/b] to [b]hero[/b].
[/list]

[h3]Trials of the Zero to Hero Challenge:[/h3]
Thine path to glory is paved with tasks that shall demand the finest in survival and combat:
[list]
[*][b]Gathering Basics:[/b]
[list]
[*]Collect 10 pieces of wood.
[*]Collect 5 pieces of stone.
[*]Craft a basic axe and pickaxe.
[/list]
[*][b]Shelter & Safety:[/b]
[list]
[*]Build a small shelter with a door.
[*]Craft a bedroll and set thy spawn point.
[/list]
[*][b]Defensive Preparations:[/b]
[list]
[*]Craft or find a full set of basic armor.
[*]Craft a weapon to defend thyself.
[/list]
[*][b]Combat Trial:[/b]
[list]
[*]Defeat 5 wild beasts, be they wolves or deer.
[*]Claim victory over a foe in [b]PVP combat[/b] (one kill shalt suffice).
[/list]
[*][b]Exploration & Discovery:[/b]
[list]
[*]Find and gather a rare resource, be it iron or herbs of great value.
[*]Discover a [b]Hell Portal[/b], the gateway to realms most foul.
[/list]
[*][b]Boss Battle:[/b]
[list]
[*]Defeat the dreaded [b]King Boss[/b] and claim thine ultimate victory.
[/list]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/590d4de442875b0df7585ad129425e1fe1f761d9.jpg[/img]
[h3]Rules of the Challenge:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Starting Conditions:[/b] All adventurers shall begin with [b]no items or equipment[/b] from prior ventures. Ye must rely solely upon what the land offers and thy own cunning.
[*][b]No Outside Help:[/b] Assistance from others is forbidden! Each hero must complete the trials by their own strength and wits.
[*][b]Proof of Completion:[/b] Verily, ye must provide [b]screenshots or video evidence[/b] for each challenge completed. Only then shalt thy victories be acknowledged.
[*][b]Time Limit:[/b] All tasks must be finished within the [b]two-hour limit[/b] to claim the title of hero.
[/list]

[h3]Become a Legend:[/h3]
Dost thou have what it takes to rise from nothing and stand triumphant? Only the most resourceful, the bravest, and the most determined shall conquer these trials. The path is steep, the dangers many, but the [b]rewards[/b] are great for those who prevail.

Will ye ascend to the ranks of Crestfallen's greatest heroes and have thy name etched in the annals of history? The world awaits thy answer.

[h3]Prizes![/h3]
[list=1]
[*][b]1st Place:[/b] 2 Crestfallen Steam Keys
[*][b]2nd Place:[/b] 1 Crestfallen Steam Key
[*][b]3rd Place:[/b] 1 Crestfallen Steam Key
[/list]


[h2]Good luck, brave adventurers! May thy strength and resolve carry thee to victory![/h2]

[h3]A Longer Dance with the Demon Lord![/h3]
The foul [b]Diablo[/b], Lord of Hell's Spawns, doth grow more elusive. Hark! The time between the arrival of his cursed demon minions hath been stretched from 25 to 45 seconds. Thee and thy companions shalt now have greater opportunity to steel thine courage and deliver righteous death upon the dread demon lord. Gather your finest arms and storm his lair, for victory awaits the bold!

[previewyoutube=060Fh16FzNw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Waters of Tyraellia Shine True[/h3]
The waters and lakes of Tyraellia have been touched by the hand of the gods themselves! Their reflections now shimmer more vividly and true, beckoning the weary to partake in their cool embrace. Whether thou art in need of respite after a long day of battle or seeking a moment's peace in the heat of high summer, take solace in the newfound clarity of these sacred waters.

[h3]The Crystal of Cognitive Conquest[/h3]
Behold! The arcane powers have gifted thee a new wonder—a [b]Purple Crystal of Cognitive Conquest[/b], now craftable at the dark [b]Black Cauldron[/b]. This crystal is said to contain the most potent power of experience gain in all of Tyraellia. Seek it, craft it, and let its mystic force propel thee to heights of mastery heretofore unimagined!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/8f16c412eb0225f782ce1e286cc6bd2147c930ba.png[/img]

[h3]The Call of the Admins Grows Stronger[/h3]
The [b]Admin Panel[/b] hath been enhanced, giving thee the guiding hand of the stewards of Tyraellia. notes.title: Edicts of Forge and Flame - Dispatches of Swift Repair, Hotfix Highlights
notes.content:
Greetings, brave souls of Crestfallen,

What an exhilarating first day it has been! We extend our deepest gratitude to each and every one of you who embarked on this journey with us. Your enthusiasm and feedback have been invaluable as we navigate the uncharted realms of our new world.

In the wake of our launch, we've been hard at work addressing your initial experiences and concerns. Here are some of the key fixes and adjustments we've implemented:

[b]Increased Server Capacity[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/6fe3e300ff761e2642bcf49630dbe7c3270fe16d.jpg[/img]

Our servers can now comfortably accommodate up to 50 players at a time, ensuring smoother gameplay and reduced wait times.

[b]Improved Player Re-connection [/b]

Players should no longer encounter issues with getting stuck on loading screens when reconnecting to the game.

[b]Bulwark of Castle Wall[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/3c312d0fbb14539bc501bc1cb110e8027ad37112.png[/img]

Slow down siege and raider attacks drastically. Castle Wall, Castle Gate, and Castle Turret Hit Points have been buffed from 35,000 hp to 350,000 hp. They now are more secure than stone wall for raid defense.

[b]Weapon Balancing[/b]

The damage of the Steel T3 Halberd has been adjusted from 205 to 150, with durability reduced from 500 to 50. These changes aim to balance gameplay and reduce raiding efficiency.

[b]Camera Stability[/b]

We've disabled camera shake for players who are not actively casting Meteor spells, enhancing overall visual comfort during gameplay.

[b]Spell Adjustments [/b]

Meteor and fire spells have been overhauled to ensure they no longer inadvertently damage internal structures and are more finely tuned for balance.

[b]Teleportation Mechanics[/b]

Teleportation is now too expensive to cast, but for those cunning enough to uncover a secret path, the possibility remains open.

[b]Economic Balance[/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/83276cb711d2d02eaed06ce8438d968cec0c6f66.png[/img]

Spear racks in town and certain higher-tier loot have been strategically removed to offer new adventurers a more balanced starting experience.

[b]Better Burn Rate[/b]

Wall torches and  candelabras are now burning fuel at a much slower rate so you wont have to refill often at all!

Your feedback continues to guide us as we strive to refine and perfect Crestfallen. Together, we are forging a world where every decision and adjustment aims to enhance your gameplay experience.

Stay tuned for more updates as we continue this epic journey together. Remember, your adventures shape the future of Crestfallen!

May your swords stay sharp and your spirits high.


My sword is at thy service,

King Burkheart The Keeper of Justice
"JUSTICE WILL BE SERVED!!"

notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Knights![/h1]

We're excited to share some thrilling updates with you as we continue to enhance your gaming experience. Here's a rundown of what's new:

[b]New Features:[/b]

Weapon Holstering: Now, weapons are holstered when unequipped, and hotbar items are visibly displayed on the character.

Hell Portal Opens: The Evil King has unleashed chaos by opening a portal to Hell beneath the throne room.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/c154ff9ec8d2368fd08158f4d2a1a399a4ca8491.jpg[/img]

Demonic Cave Access: Explore new depths as the Elven Outpost unveils a portal leading to the Demonic Cave.

Enhanced Food and Thirst System: Experience a revamped UI for food and thirst, with added liquid representation for health and mana columns.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

Horse Mounting Issue Resolved: No more frustration with the horse mounting bug – it's now fixed!
Optimized Tree and Node Respawns: Enjoy smoother gameplay with optimized respawns for trees and nodes.

AI and NPC Sound Overhaul: Immerse yourself further with a complete overhaul of AI and NPC sounds.
New Death and Blood Effects: Experience more immersive gameplay with new death and blood sounds.

Improved AI Animations: NPCs now move more realistically with new animations.
Vendor Expansion: Discover new vendors including a Barbarian offering Demon Lord and barbarian gear, and a Healer vendor for reagents and potions.

Interactive Station Sound Overhaul: Enjoy a more immersive experience with complete sound overhauls on all interactable stations, chests, and objects.

Enhanced Loot Search Interface: Navigate large items more efficiently with a new search interface featuring a circular UI and time search to uncover specific loot areas.

New Enemies: Encounter new adversaries such as Knights, cultists, and vikings on your adventures.

[b]Improvements:[/b]

Crystal and Drink Animations: Crystal animations and drink consumption animations have been enhanced for a more polished gaming experience.

[b]Adjustments:[/b]

Monster Reduction: Addressing player feedback, approximately 25% of on-map monsters, thugs, and wolves have been removed to balance gameplay and reduce frustration.

Nighttime Visibility:  Dark nights have been removed to ensure players can still navigate and enjoy the game during nighttime.
